# Row

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-component-docs.mjs from ai/component-catalog.json and ai/component-composition.json. Do not edit; run `npm run catalog:sync`. -->

`@kerfjs/ui:row` · Kerf UI · component · Structure

A horizontal flex row with physical-axis alignment, side-selectable text/control insets, a typed xs gap by default, flex participation, and opt-in wrapping.

## When to use

Arrange related content horizontally with consistent spacing, optional physical-side text/control insets, and explicit left/center/right/full plus top/middle/bottom/full/baseline alignment instead of application-owned flex wrappers.

- Arrange a group of sibling components horizontally.
- Choose physical horizontal distribution and vertical alignment without writing one-off flex CSS.
- Use a finite flex keyword or the flex() builder when Row participates in a flexible parent layout.
- Allow a bounded group to wrap while retaining the same typed gap and alignment contract.
- Apply the standard text or control inset to selected physical sides without an application wrapper.

**Not when:**

- Do not use Row when content belongs in a semantic list or when a named-zone component such as Toolbar owns the composition.
- Do not pass raw CSS strings to gap or flex, mix their distinct grammars, or use s/xl spacing steps without a deliberate exception.
- Do not use alignment to replace semantic grouping or responsive relocation.

**Alternatives:**

- [List](./list.md) (axis-alternative) — Use List when the main layout axis is vertical.
- [Toolbar](./toolbar.md) (semantic-alternative) — Use Toolbar when content belongs to named leading, center, and trailing application-chrome zones.

## Imports

- JavaScript: `@kerfjs/ui/row` — exports `Row`.
- CSS: the browser build of `@kerfjs/ui/row` pulls its CSS automatically; import `@kerfjs/ui/row.css` manually only without the `browser` export condition.
- Declared side effects: browser-condition-css.

## Props

Exact prop names and types: [`@kerfjs/ui/row`](../public-api-signatures-v1.md#kerfjsuirow) in `public-api-signatures-v1.md`. Do not infer props from examples.

**Variants (configure, do not restyle):**

- left/center/right/full horizontal alignment with l/c/r/f and flex aliases
- top/middle/bottom/full vertical alignment with t/m/c/b/f and flex aliases, plus baseline alignment
- named none/2xs/xs/s/m/l/xl token gap
- typed CssLength gap
- boolean, finite-keyword, or typed CssFlex flex
- nowrap or wrapping
- top/right/bottom/left text and control inset combinations
- fill: the layout root fills a definite-height parent
- rootAttributes: safe data-\* metadata on the root

**CSS-value props** (typed builders from `@kerfjs/ui/css-values`; raw CSS strings are rejected):

- `gap`: length grammar; raw values: forbid; shorthands `none`, `2xs`, `xs`, `m`, `l`; exceptional (justify) `s`, `xl`; helpers `px`, `rem`, `em`, `pct`, `space`, `lengthVar`, `calc` — e.g. `gap="xs"`
- `flex`: flex grammar; raw values: forbid; shorthands `none`, `auto`, `initial`; helpers `flex` — e.g. `flex`

## Composition

- Parents: any.
- Contexts: `application-ui`, `horizontal-layout`.
- Children: unrestricted.

## State and wiring

**The app owns:** child semantics and content; alignment and wrapping policy; typed gap and flex choices.

No wiring helper.

## Geometry

Margin: none · border: none · padding: conditional (layout role: structure). `self` means the component already owns it — do not add wrapper padding, margin, or borders around it.

- Row adds no margin or border. textInsets adds the full 17px content inset and controlInsets adds 8px on selected physical sides; text wins when both select a side.

## Accessibility

- Row adds layout only and no grouping role; children retain responsibility for native or ARIA semantics.
- Wrapping must preserve a readable source and focus order.

## Styling boundary

The component owns its own styles. Configure it through its props and variants; do not override its internals.

Public class hooks (select for layout placement only, never to change the component's look): `kui-row`.

Public tokens it reads: `--kui-layout-item-gap`, `--kui-row-gap`. Set a token only where its public contract allows; prefer a prop.

Everything else is internal: `kerf-ui-analyze` reports private or unknown `.kui-*` selectors (`KUI-L001`, `KUI-L010`), unknown or private tokens (`KUI-L002`, `KUI-L012`), and any application rule that restyles the component, forced dimensions included (`KUI-L019`).
